implementation.title: Create frozen dataclass data models

Each model includes to_dict() and from_dict() methods.

implementation.title: Implement QuintileSorter
implementation.description: Create synapse/backtest/quintile.py with QuintileSorter class. Methods: sort(factor_values: pd.Series, target_date: date, n_quintiles: int = 5) -> QuintilePortfolio for single-date sorting, and sort_timeseries(factor_values: pd.DataFrame, rebalance_dates: list[date]) -> dict[date, QuintilePortfolio] for multi-date sorting. Use pd.qcut() for efficient quintile assignment. Handle edge cases: all NaN factors, fewer than 5 stocks, ties in ranking.
modification_points: Implement sort() method: extract factor values at target_date, rank with method='first', assign to n_quintiles groups using pd.qcut, create QuintilePortfolio with equal weights
Implement sort_timeseries() method: iterate rebalance_dates, call sort() for each, return dict
Handle edge cases: skip dates with < n_quintiles valid stocks, skip all-NaN dates, use method='first' for deterministic ties
logic_flow: Extract factor values for target_date from MultiIndex DataFrame
Drop NaN values, validate >= n_quintiles stocks available
Assign quintile labels using pd.qcut(ranked, q=n_quintiles, labels=range(1, n_quintiles+1))
Compute equal weights: 1/count for each stock in each quintile
Return frozen QuintilePortfolio with quintile labels and weights
